text: M11 L14 `m11dcmds` (ROOT_NOT_FOUND bullet) says the page router `/api/pages/:rootId/...` resolves ONLY `kind: pages` roots and that the list in `hint` never names a system root. M02 `l4rootseg` (2.1.14) says `:rootId` resolves every root WITH A FACADE (sidebar not `hidden`), and the `skills` root (M52, a system kind with a reducer sidebar) has one — so the router resolves `skills` and its ROOT_NOT_FOUND hint lists it (`roots in this project: pages, …, skills`), as the 2.1.9 facade-roots tests pin. Assumed: the router keeps M02's facade rule and its hint lists the facade roots; for the cases the criteria name (`plans`, an unknown id) M11 holds — both get the identical ROOT_NOT_FOUND and `plans` is never listed.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:m11r-dev-0002 — the ROOT_NOT_FOUND hint lists the facade roots M02 resolves (`skills` included), not only `kind: pages`.
